entities.name: Robert de Beaumont, 3rd Earl of Leicester

entities.summary: Robert de Beaumont, 3rd Earl of Leicester, called Blanchemains, was an English nobleman, one of the principal followers of Henry the Young King in the Revolt of 1173–1174 against his father King Henry II.
